notes.title: Sundered: Medlife Goes Insane!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26407997/31ea1fad6a6b113659ed081477082b7df9eff7d9.gif[/img]

Hey everyone!

Long time no speak! Hope you're all staying happy and healthy out there.

As you may be aware, our good friends at the [b]Indie MEGABOOTH[/b] are holding an epic [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/indiemegabooth]"Going Away (for now) Sale"[/url], and [b]Sundered: Eldritch Edition[/b] is being offered at its crazy most! generous! ever! discount! Perfect opportunity to snag an extra copy for that special someone, hmm?

To celebrate, and because we really don't see y'all often enough, we'll be doing a [b]live stream on Saturday, May 9th @ 3pm EDT[/b]! That's [u]tomorrow[/u], in case all your days are melding together because time has no meaning right now. (p.s. I feel ya.)

And this is no ordinary stream! It'll feature our very own resident Sundered guru, he who has logged thousands of hours in the game, and broken it more times than we can count. I am referring to none other than [b]Med [/b]([url=https://www.twitch.tv/medlife]Medlife [/url]to those in the know)!

Hope to see you there!

Cheers,

- Rodrigue and the Thunder Lotus Team

notes.title: We've announced our next game: Spiritfarer!
notes.content:
[h1]A cozy management game about dying[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32943393/6376b80db970593c6781aae309e2c50d6f011741.jpg[/img]

Hey everyone!

It’s a big red letter day here at Thunder Lotus! We’re super stoked to finally reveal the project we’ve been lovingly crafting over the past 18 months or so. Behold [i]Spiritfarer[/i]: a cozy management game about dying.

Queue our first trailer and prepare thyselves for the feels!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YnuEvePlxWI

[i]Spiritfarer [/i]is a project that’s near and dear to our hearts. Here’s the basic pitch:

In [i]Spiritfarer[/i], you play Stella, ferrymaster to the deceased. Build a boat to explore the world, then befriend and care for spirits before finally releasing them into the afterlife. Farm, mine, fish, harvest, cook, and craft your way across mystical seas. Join the adventure as Daffodil the cat, in two-player cooperative play. Spend relaxing quality time with your spirit passengers, create lasting memories, and, ultimately, learn how to say goodbye to your cherished friends.

Expect a release next year on Steam, as well as with Xbox Game Pass for PC and Console, Xbox One, PS4, and Nintendo Switch!

We can’t wait to tell you more about the game over the next few days, weeks, and months.

Today, as I write this, we’re enjoying the frenzy of [b]E3 2019[/b], where we’ve been invited by the good people at Microsoft to present the first playable demo of [i]Spiritfarer [/i]as part of their E3 activities. Come say hi at the Microsoft Theater if you’re in town for the convention! If not, maybe we’re coming to another con near you over the next few months, hmm? 

Stay tuned (and do please [b]Follow [/b]or Wishlist [i]Spiritfarer[/i])!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/972660/Spiritfarer/

Back to you soon with more Spiritfarer news!

Cheers y’all,

– Rodrigue and the Thunder Lotus team

notes.title: Sundered: Eldritch Edition is out NOW!
notes.content:
[h1]Existing players receive Eldritch Edition as a free update today![/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32943393/17548c22b88bba4ef0bdf99402281d724c54f8ad.gif[/img]

Hey folks!

Today, we're unleashing [b]Sundered: Eldritch Edition[/b], the definitive edition of of our chaotic metroidvania, containing all previous updates published to the game, along with the brand new [b]Magnate of the Gong update[/b]! Here’s what’s being added in this latest version:

[list]
    [*][b]Local co-op:[/b] It’s dangerous to go alone, especially through [i]Sundered’s [/i]ever-changing caverns. So we’ve added local co-op multiplayer support for up to 4 players!

    [*][b]New areas and quest chain:[/b] We’ve added several unique new areas throughout the existing map. Complete a quest chain of special challenges in the new areas to unlock rewards and the path to a brand new boss!
[/list]
And that’s just the big stuff! We’ve added a ton of smaller features and improvements under the hood! Check out the full patch notes [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/535480/discussions/0/1742229167175158535/]HERE[/url].

And to be clear, yes, all existing players receive the Eldritch Edition update for FREE today!

Please remember that your feedback is crucial for us, [b]so please do leave or update your review[/b] on our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/535480/Sundered/] Store page[/url], and strike up a conversation about this update with us on our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/535480/discussions/] Forums[/url]! 

Resist or Embrace.

- Rodrigue and the Thunder Lotus Team

notes.title: Happy #LoveIndies Week!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32943393/173cd37a845c01bd84cac9a2417e510df912bf0b.png[/img]

Hey everyone,

The fine folks at [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/failbettergames]Failbetter Games[/url] (creators of TLG favorite, the richly textured seafaring survival exploration game [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/304650/SUNLESS_SEA/]Sunless Sea[/url]) have kicked off [b]#LoveIndies Week[/b], an event with the goal of celebrating indie games and their communities, while also highlighting how reviews can be a massive help to developers! Such a lovely initiative on their part!

In the spirit of the celebration, we’d like to officially re-iterate what we don’t mention nearly enough: [b]the Thunder Lotus community is our family[/b]. Your trust and support is at the root of our work, and we never take it for granted. [b]Thank you[/b] for supporting Thunder Lotus Games – we wouldn’t be able to do what we love without you!

[h1]Please show your love during #LoveIndies Week![/h1]

You might not know how much a simple review or rating can mean to an indie development team. They [b]absolutely do make a huge difference to us[/b]: to our morale, visibility and sales. 

All this week we’re going to recommend games from other studios that we love, and [b]we hope you’ll take the time to rate, review and recommend indie games that you’ve loved here on Steam[/b] as well. Spread the love on social with the [url=https://twitter.com/hashtag/loveindies]#LoveIndies[/url] hashtag too!

Check out our latest indie game recommendations on our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/thunderlotus]Steam Developer Page![/url]

Have a great #LoveIndies Week, y'all!

- Rodrigue and the Thunder Lotus Team

notes.title: The Sundered Finisher Update Has Been Unleashed!
notes.content:
[h1] Featuring Fabulously Furious Final Flourishes!	[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26407997/796415ddadcaeaeb335932626fc193d325254a18.png[/img]

Hey everyone,

We’re totally stoked to be unleashing the long-awaited [i]Sundered[/i] [b]Finisher Update[/b], chock-full of delicious quality of life improvements and the badass titular [b]finishing moves[/b] that will have you obliterating eldritch hordes in style! The  [i]Sundered[/i] [b]Finisher Update[/b] arrives automatically as a [b]free[/b] update to all Steam players today. Important [b]additional updates to Sundered are still to come![/b]

Here’s what’s in store for y’all in the [b]Finisher Update[/b]:

[list]
    [*][b]Added a set of new combat moves we call Finishers.[/b] Once a certain number of melee attacks have been landed in a short time frame, a powerful Finisher attack is ready to be unleashed! Finishers are available from the start of the game
    [*][b]Huge balance pass[/b] to make the game smoother and reduce moments where grind feels necessary: Reworked and improved early game pacing; Increased shard drops in the early game.
    [*][b]Expanded the skill tree[/b] with new nodes and rebalanced some stat multipliers and perks.
    [*][b]Defeated bosses can be fought again[/b] for reduced rewards.
    [*][b]Added player markers[/b] to help locate the player in crowded or zoomed out locations (can be toggled in the options).
    [*][b]Tweaked minimap legend[/b] so each icon is more easily recognizable.
    [*][b]Modified tip system[/b] so as to not spoil content that is not yet accessible to the player.
    [*][b]Reduced loading times[/b] and stabilized frame rate (hurray!).
    [*]Other minor bug fixes.
[/list]

Please remember that your feedback is crucial for us, [b]so please do leave or update your review[/b] on our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/535480/Sundered/] Store page	[/url], and strike up a conversation about this update with us on our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/535480/discussions/] Forums[/url]! 

[h1]ICYMI: The "Not-A-Metroidvania" Bundle![/h1]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/7135/Not_a_Metroidvania/][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26407997/4507355ba11c2f5c53dfe7a7f9648809f3369396.png[/img][/url]

Finally, don’t forget that the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/7135/Not_a_Metroidvania/] Not-A-Metroidvania Bundle[/url] is still live, and that you stand to save a pretty penny on some of the best games of the-genre-that-shall-not-be-named, especially with the deeper Summer Sale discounts! 

Resist or Embrace.

- Rodrigue and the Thunder Lotus Team

notes.title: Frost Warning on Nintendo Switch!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6918539/3fb53515466d9814bbcd4275b42bd880403f03b9.png[/img]

[h1] Jotun Thunders onto Nintendo Switch in Two Weeks! [/h1]

Hey everyone,  

Truly stoked to share this epic news with y'all: get ready for six more weeks of winter, as we're finally bringing [i]Jotun[/i] to the Nintendo Switch! [i]Jotun: Valhalla Edition[/i] drops on the vaunted console worldwide on [b]April 27th, 2018![/b]  

Have a gander at the launch trailer, why dontcha?

[url=https://youtu.be/lAN263KlreM] [img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6918539/7445b45bd7c4c981f03c33a4221789be208601c1.png[/img][/url]

Needless to say, we're very excited to be bringing our first game to the Switch - we're all life-long Nintendo fans over here, and have been in absolute lurve with the Switch since launch. 

We wanted to take the time and make sure we were bringing the best possible version of [i]Jotun[/i] to the system. Happily, the Switch has the horsepower to showcase [i]Jotun[/i] in all its hand-drawn glory, even in handheld mode, so those who played the Wii U version especially will notice the great job the team has done remastering the graphics for the Switch release. 

Also, since we play a lot with scale in [i]Jotun,[/i] Thora often being dwarfed by titanic bosses, we had to rework some of the gameplay to allow for play on a potentially much smaller screen. 

[h1]Keep your eyes on our social channels for a chance to win!  [/h1]

We hope you're all stoked to play the game on the Switch and, say, to beat Valhalla Mode without using God Powers *while commuting to work*!  

We're so happy to finally have one of our games on the Switch that [b]we'll be holding drawings to win Jotun Switch codes and other sweet goodies! [/b] Recommend you stay tuned to our social channels between now and launch day, is all I'm sayin'...  

[url=https://www.facebook.com/ThunderLotusGames/] Facebook[/url] | [url=https://twitter.com/ThunderLotus] Twitter [/url]

So stay frosty, y'all! Jotun is out on Switch in two weeks! 

[h1]What's happening with Sundered?[/h1]

That's a very good question, Bill! 

The team remains hard at work lovingly polishing delicious DLC for the game. I can confirm that said DLC has been content-complete for a few weeks (and that it's awesome), but we're still tweaking it 'til it's up to your/our standards of excellence. We're tantalizingly close to being able to share [i]Sundered [/i]news with you - news that goes beyond the DLC itself. If I say anymore, I'll be summarily killed. But I assure y'all that you won't be disappointed.

Stay tuned!

- Rodrigue and the Thunder Lotus

notes.title: Happy Holidays! Our Year in Review!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6918539/2ab75398537e6e150f3b65d09c99c7f57769b077.png[/img]

[h1][b]Happy Holidays from Thunder Lotus![/b][/h1]

Hey everyone,

We're celebrating the end of a banner year here at Thunder Lotus! We welcomed over [b] two million [/b] new TLG game owners to the family in 2017, and wanted to thank each and every one of you for your overwhelming support of [i] Jotun [/i] and [i] Sundered [/i]! Happy Holidays from all of us here at Thunder Lotus Games to the best damn fans in gaming!

Below, I'm sharing a look back on our last twelve months, but I'd be remiss if I didn't first direct your attention to the [b] Thunder Lotus Collection! [/b] 

[url=http://store.steampowered.com/bundle/5432/The_Thunder_Lotus_Collection/] [img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6918539/da279b902b3507a0746d5919930bfbaab04fd72a.png[/img] [/url]

We're happy to report that both [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/323580/Jotun_Valhalla_Edition/]Jotun[/url] and [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/535480/Sundered/]Sundered[/url] are on sale for the [b] Steam Winter Sale, [/b]with [i] Sundered [/i] enjoying its [b] deepest discount yet [/b] at -50%! If you were still on the fence about [i] Sundered,[/i] it's a great time to pick it up (and spread the word)!

Do note as well that [url=http://store.steampowered.com/bundle/5432/The_Thunder_Lotus_Collection/]The Thunder Lotus Collection[/url] adds an [b] extra -10% discount [/b] on top of that if you purchase our titles together (or are looking to complete your collection!). It's a crazy good deal, yo - worth a share, dontcha think?

This concludes our yuletide PSA. And now...

[h1][b]Our Year In Pictures[/b][/h1]

We wanted to take a moment to look back on a wonderful (and wonderfully busy) year for our team!  

We hit the ground running in [b]January[/b] this year, putting the finishing touches on a then-secret Kickstarter project [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/thunderlotus/sundered-a-horrifying-fight-for-survival-and-sanit/]that you should all be quite familiar with by now![/url] Here, Will goofs off with Sam from [url=http://store.steampowered.com/search/?developer=Compulsion%20Games]Compulsion Games[/url] during the filming of a Kickstarter promo video: 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6918539/d457ec27e25aa89a24a535fe47f881ca2d594264.png[/img]

It was a stellar month: thanks to our awesome fans, we quickly [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/thunderlotus/sundered-a-horrifying-fight-for-survival-and-sanit/posts/1785423]powered through funding milestones[/url] throughout the first hours and days of the campaign, and meanwhile, we were declared co-winners of the [url=http://quebec.ubisoft.com/en/winners-of-the-ubisoft-indie-series-presented-by-national-bank/]Ubisoft Indie Series![/url] 

[url=http://quebec.ubisoft.com/en/winners-of-the-ubisoft-indie-series-presented-by-national-bank/][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6918539/ed56cb0a8f056a7558c288225d3c0be7db1bcede.jpg[/img][/url] 

Oh, and we caught the eye of one of our heroes. 

[url=https://twitter.com/RealGDT/status/823204924011978754][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6918539/d1eb183431ffc2494df8668b23bec4a212972908.png[/img][/url]

January also kicked off a series of cross-country trips which brought us first to [b]PAX South[/b] in San Antonio.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6918539/9ad5e876c5edbd29a18b9b6f9b1f354a7e8e21dd.jpg[/img]

With our backers' tremendous support, we closed [i]Sundered's[/i] Kickstarter campaign in February [b]800% funded,[/b] due in no small part to the surprise announcement of our partnership with the lovely and talented folks at [b]Limited Run Games.[/b] (LRG's Doug pictured here with our Art Director at MIX!)

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6918539/e3e097e4003743a5c92b85dc3bc35beaac7a4135.jpg[/img] 

In March, our travels brought us down to the IGN offices, where we were invited to sign their wall of fame, humbled by names of gaming royalty that had come before us. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6918539/ece4a53cd9818acbe539ba66a702e904e27e9de6.jpg[/img]

Later that month, we brought a small Thunder Lotus army down to Boston to greet enthusiastic fans and media at [b]PAX East.[/b]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6918539/ee77de446b829bfebaf4fc5129a34f72f2033c62.jpg[/img]

Spring found us bearing down in earnest through the rounds of [i]Sundered’s[/i] Alpha and Beta periods, while our resident hand-drawn animation genius’ prodigious output continued unabated.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6918539/a8339b54ee286ab6fc491e628bcd2ab40a818d29.jpg[/img]  

Our appearance at the sunshiny [b]E3 gigantocon[/b] heralded the coming of summer and the last straightaway leading to [i]Sundered’s[/i] July release!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6918539/39fb49eb54e9852622cd5412d7b3ebf9cbe09e46.jpg[/img]

By summer, production was rolling a mile a minute, a blur of incessant testing, tweaking, testing, re-tooling, and testing while [b]gorgeous fan art[/b] multiplied on the walls of our office.  

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6918539/81d1b0e8c37edc6c7993c94f2e3a207966d33cc7.jpg[/img]

In July, a [i]Jotun[/i] free weekend added [b]two million people[/b] (of exquisite taste) to the Thunder Lotus family overnight, and before we could say [b]R'lehshyshtag',[/b] [i]Sundered[/i] was unleashed upon the world, happily catching the eye of the likes of Rock, Paper, Shotgun (among many others)!

[url=https://www.rockpapershotgun.com/2017/08/09/sundered-review/][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6918539/9d751ed7e63e3722b4e81d9ef695b5c273199154.png[/img][/url]

Upon our return from much needed vacation time in the fall, we kept a low profile, working in hushed secrecy on [spoiler]Sundered DLC...[/spoiler]

While bringing a new creative director onto the team to head up our [b]“Top Secret!, OMG! That’s so awesome!”[/b] third project. (Gonna be a while before we can tell you more - sorry/not sorry for the tease!) ːsteammockingː

Meet Nicolas Guérin, who has that fresh "new creative director" smell!

[url=https://thunderlotusgames.com/meet-our-new-creative-director/][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6918539/8c7a51115ec6b561258837120680f26d72df43a0.jpg[/img][/url]

[h1][b]Much love from all of us here![/b][/h1]

That’s all she wrote, folks! Stick a fork in 2017, it’s fully done!  

From all of us here, thanks again for helping to make this the best year yet for Thunder Lotus! Stay happy and healthy this holiday season, and we’ll see you in the new year!

Cheers, and much love!  

- Rodrigue and the Thunder Lotus Team

notes.title: Happy Holidays! Our Year in Review!
notes.content:

Below, I'm sharing a look back on our last twelve months, but I'd be remiss if I didn't first direct your attention to the [b] Thunder Lotus Collection! [/b] 

[url=http://store.steampowered.com/bundle/5432/The_Thunder_Lotus_Collection/] [img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6918539/da279b902b3507a0746d5919930bfbaab04fd72a.png[/img] [/url]

We're happy to report that both [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/323580/Jotun_Valhalla_Edition/]Jotun[/url] and [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/535480/Sundered/]Sundered[/url] are on sale for the [b] Steam Winter Sale, [/b]with [i] Sundered [/i] enjoying its [b] deepest discount yet [/b] at -50%! If you were still on the fence about [i] Sundered,[/i] it's a great time to pick it up (and spread the word)!

Do note as well that [url=http://store.steampowered.com/bundle/5432/The_Thunder_Lotus_Collection/]The Thunder Lotus Collection[/url] adds an [b] extra -10% discount [/b] on top of that if you purchase our titles together (or are looking to complete your collection!). It's a crazy good deal, yo - worth a share, dontcha think?

This concludes our yuletide PSA. And now...

[h1][b]Our Year In Pictures[/b][/h1]

We wanted to take a moment to look back on a wonderful (and wonderfully busy) year for our team!  

We hit the ground running in [b]January[/b] this year, putting the finishing touches on a then-secret Kickstarter project [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/thunderlotus/sundered-a-horrifying-fight-for-survival-and-sanit/]that you should all be quite familiar with by now![/url] Here, Will goofs off with Sam from [url=http://store.steampowered.com/search/?developer=Compulsion%20Games]Compulsion Games[/url] during the filming of a Kickstarter promo video: 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6918539/d457ec27e25aa89a24a535fe47f881ca2d594264.png[/img]

It was a stellar month: thanks to our awesome fans, we quickly [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/thunderlotus/sundered-a-horrifying-fight-for-survival-and-sanit/posts/1785423]powered through funding milestones[/url] throughout the first hours and days of the campaign, and meanwhile, we were declared co-winners of the [url=http://quebec.ubisoft.com/en/winners-of-the-ubisoft-indie-series-presented-by-national-bank/]Ubisoft Indie Series![/url] 

[url=http://quebec.ubisoft.com/en/winners-of-the-ubisoft-indie-series-presented-by-national-bank/][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6918539/ed56cb0a8f056a7558c288225d3c0be7db1bcede.jpg[/img][/url] 

Oh, and we caught the eye of one of our heroes. 

[url=https://twitter.com/RealGDT/status/823204924011978754][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6918539/d1eb183431ffc2494df8668b23bec4a212972908.png[/img][/url]

January also kicked off a series of cross-country trips which brought us first to [b]PAX South[/b] in San Antonio.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6918539/9ad5e876c5edbd29a18b9b6f9b1f354a7e8e21dd.jpg[/img]

With our backers' tremendous support, we closed [i]Sundered's[/i] Kickstarter campaign in February [b]800% funded,[/b] due in no small part to the surprise announcement of our partnership with the lovely and talented folks at [b]Limited Run Games.[/b] (LRG's Doug pictured here with our Art Director at MIX!)

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6918539/e3e097e4003743a5c92b85dc3bc35beaac7a4135.jpg[/img] 

In March, our travels brought us down to the IGN offices, where we were invited to sign their wall of fame, humbled by names of gaming royalty that had come before us. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6918539/ece4a53cd9818acbe539ba66a702e904e27e9de6.jpg[/img]

Later that month, we brought a small Thunder Lotus army down to Boston to greet enthusiastic fans and media at [b]PAX East.[/b]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6918539/ee77de446b829bfebaf4fc5129a34f72f2033c62.jpg[/img]

Spring found us bearing down in earnest through the rounds of [i]Sundered’s[/i] Alpha and Beta periods, while our resident hand-drawn animation genius’ prodigious output continued unabated.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6918539/a8339b54ee286ab6fc491e628bcd2ab40a818d29.jpg[/img]  

Our appearance at the sunshiny [b]E3 gigantocon[/b] heralded the coming of summer and the last straightaway leading to [i]Sundered’s[/i] July release!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6918539/39fb49eb54e9852622cd5412d7b3ebf9cbe09e46.jpg[/img]

By summer, production was rolling a mile a minute, a blur of incessant testing, tweaking, testing, re-tooling, and testing while [b]gorgeous fan art[/b] multiplied on the walls of our office.  

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6918539/81d1b0e8c37edc6c7993c94f2e3a207966d33cc7.jpg[/img]

In July, a [i]Jotun[/i] free weekend added [b]two million people[/b] (of exquisite taste) to the Thunder Lotus family overnight, and before we could say [b]R'lehshyshtag',[/b] [i]Sundered[/i] was unleashed upon the world, happily catching the eye of the likes of Rock, Paper, Shotgun (among many others)!

[url=https://www.rockpapershotgun.com/2017/08/09/sundered-review/][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6918539/9d751ed7e63e3722b4e81d9ef695b5c273199154.png[/img][/url]

Upon our return from much needed vacation time in the fall, we kept a low profile, working in hushed secrecy on [spoiler]Sundered DLC...[/spoiler]

While bringing a new creative director onto the team to head up our [b]“Top Secret!, OMG! That’s so awesome!”[/b] third project. (Gonna be a while before we can tell you more - sorry/not sorry for the tease!) ːsteammockingː

Meet Nicolas Guérin, who has that fresh "new creative director" smell!

[url=https://thunderlotusgames.com/meet-our-new-creative-director/][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6918539/8c7a51115ec6b561258837120680f26d72df43a0.jpg[/img][/url]

[h1][b]Much love from all of us here![/b][/h1]

That’s all she wrote, folks! Stick a fork in 2017, it’s fully done!  

From all of us here, thanks again for helping to make this the best year yet for Thunder Lotus! Stay happy and healthy this holiday season, and we’ll see you in the new year!

Cheers, and much love!  

- Rodrigue and the Thunder Lotus Team

notes.title: Week 1: Done!
notes.content:
[url=http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26407997/7bf70daf5dad56b0649575324fc7a5f11f9e7910.jpg][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26407997/6ca4b8441347a2b4da4da31b5252b1ce02ac0094.jpg[/img][/url]

[h1]A word of thanks from Sundered's Creative Director.[/h1]

Wow.

Launch week is over.

As always, it was crazy. There’s nothing like the feeling of jumping off a cliff without a parachute.

And we made it.

We’re thankful for all of you who believed in us and supported us and the game. [b]Thank you all[/b] for giving [i]Sundered[/i] a chance.

We are extremely proud of the game we created, produced and shipped. I feel the game is unique and challenging and, once you get the hang of it, really fun. I hope [i]Sundered[/i] is a game you will remember for a long time.

At launch, we had some hiccups. Some of them due to excessive difficulty. We fixed that almost immediately. We’re experiencing technical difficulties on PS4. We’re fixing them. The game’s first loading is too long. We’re fixing it. Exploration doesn’t have enough variety. We’re fixing that too.

Some of you don’t like the hordes. We’re not changing them. Several of you came in with expectations of a classic Metroidvania. We are sorry for the confusion, but we won’t be changing fundamental game systems. [i]Sundered[/i] is what is it is and that’s why we love it and are proud of it.

Looking to the future, you can expect continued support. Be it additional content, bug fixes or quality-of-life improvements. [i]Sundered[/i] has tons of potential. Seeing some of you put in over 50 hours into the game within a single week is extremely satisfying and humbling. We know the game isn’t perfect, but we’re fiercely proud of the step up we took from [i]Jotun[/i]. And we can’t wait to show you what we’re doing next.

We wish you all the best, and, from everyone here at Thunder Lotus:

[b]Resist or Embrace.[/b]

- Will Dubé, President & CEO, Thunder Lotus Games

notes.title: 08/04/2017 Patch Notes
notes.content:
The new patch is live! If you experienced any game breaking issue, I have made the previous patch available through the Steam beta tab. To access it, open the game steam properties, select the beta tab and select previouspatch from the dropdown list. Please let us know if you encounter anything major so that we can fix it ASAP!

[h1]08/04/2017 Patch Notes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed T3 perks not dropping from the Cathedral corrupted chests.
[*]Fixed some corrupted chests challenges in the Cathedral.
[*]All monsters will now die when you trigger a miniboss or a story room crystal.
[*]Tweaked spikes color in the first region to be more visible.
[*]Corrupted chests now appear on the map when you have scavenger.
[*]Harvester perk changed. Now reduced armor instead of life.
[*]Shield Absorb values changed from 15/25/35 to 10/15/20.
[*]Various bug fixes and optimizations (sorry loading has not improved yet).
[/list]

[h1]07/31/2017 Patch Notes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Build now 64-bit by default. 32-bit version available through steam beta tab.
[*] Fix issue causing frequent frame drops in the first region.
[*] Fix gamepad binding not being saved properly.
[*] Made endless hordes areas more obvious.
[*] Reduced the duration of Hordes in the first region when running away.
[*] Added anticipation to mage walls.
[*] Rank 2 perks can no longer drop from R1 arena. Rank 3 perks can no longer drop from R2 arenas.
[*] Fix smash attack not working properly when rebinding attack on a gamepad.
[*] Perks are now affected by the magnet after 5 seconds.
[*] Various bug fixes and optimizations.
[/list]

[h1]07/31/2017 Patch Notes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added pseudo invulnerability time when getting hit by monsters (cap the amount of damage you can take in a time frame after getting hit).
[/list]

notes.title: We're bringing Sundered to Kickstarter! (and have confirmed our release date!)
notes.content:
[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/thunderlotus/1569490481?token=26e71699] [img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26407997/31a87522a054c3a2cc8d15703efcb70eabaefa0c.jpg[/img][/url]

[h1] [i]Sundered[/i] Is On Kickstarter! [/h1]

Hey everyone! Huge news today, as we're revealing our [i]Sundered[/i] Kickstarter campaign!

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/thunderlotus/1569490481?token=26e71699] --> Preview the Sundered Kickstarter campaign (and share it too!) [/url]

We had a small, dedicated army of backers with us throughout the crucial testing phase of the [i]Jotun[/i] project, so we know firsthand how crucial the input of enthusiastic alpha and beta players is for making a good game [i]something special[/i]. To all the fans we've proudly recruited since day one, we want to be abundantly clear: we simply couldn't imagine completing [i]Sundered[/i] without repeating that great Kickstarter experience.

In short, the campaign’s goal is to get *you* involved in the process. It's about polish, feedback and making [i]Sundered[/i] the best it can be. We hope you'll check the campaign out, consider joining us for the alpha and/or beta, and share the campaign with any you believe might be interested.

[b]We'll be live on Kickstarter on January 16th[/b] - we hope to see you then! In the meantime, don't forget to click on "Notify me on launch" on our Kickstarter page so you don't miss out!

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/thunderlotus/1569490481?token=26e71699] [img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26407997/2d42a095dae6d30affcbbc4dbd8a5f364814936c.png[/img][/url]

[h1] [i]Sundered[/i] Will Be Out This Summer! [/h1]

We've included a production timeline on the Kickstarter page as well, officially revealing the release window for Sundered in the process! Set some time aside during the hot summer months to delve into Sundered's dark caverns: [b]we'll be out in July 2017![/b]

Cheers, 

#ResistOrEmbrace 

- Rodrigue and the Thunder Lotus Team

notes.title: Thunder Lotus Reveals New Sundered "Embrace" Trailer
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

We're super stoked to share the new "Embrace" trailer for [i] Sundered [/i]! The trailer features the very first images of the third region of the game - Eschaton City - along with new enemies, and a glimpse at the horrifying corruption process Eshe must undergo... should [i] you [/i] choose to have her Embrace, that is! 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26407997/c64e8e6f44c613fa7a3210da984050d6e0686452.png[/img]

You'll find the new trailer front-and-center on [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/535480/] our store page[/url] as well as our [url=https://youtu.be/w9iM9f9-DvU] our YouTube channel[/url].

The trailer was graciously revealed by Sony this morning, and we do recommend you reading through the accompanying [url=http://blog.us.playstation.com/2016/12/14/sundered-new-trailer-details-from-thunder-lotus/] PlayStation Blog post [/url] in which our Creative Director Will serves out juicy morsels of info about Sundered's gameplay!

Hope you're as excited about this trailer as we are - and if so, do please like, share, and comment!

Cheers,

#ResistOrEmbrace

- Rodrigue and the Thunder Lotus Team

notes.title: Introducing Sundered, a Horrifying Fight for Survival and Sanity
notes.content:
Hello Steam!

We are super excited to bring you Thunder Lotus' sophomore game, Sundered!

Sundered is a horrifying fight for survival and sanity. You play Eshe, a wanderer trapped in ever-changing caverns teeming with eldritch horrors.

Building on ​Jotun’s success, we took what worked from the game (the art style, big boss fights and immersion) and fused it with infinite replayability and the non­linear action-­packed gameplay of the metroidvania genre.

We hope you'll enjoy the game and can't wait to tell you more!

As always, poke us in the comments or on Facebook/Twitter and we'll be happy to answer any of your questions!

Resists or Embrace.

- Will and the Thunder Lotus Team
